Ishan Gokhale

Product designer & woodworker

My name is Ishan Gokhale. I’m a product designer and woodworker with a passion for crafting heirloom-quality pieces that blend form and function.

After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, I spent several years broadening my skill-set and crafting a purposefully eclectic career.

I designed and built robots. I worked on the factory floor making Diesel engines. I taught young children. I analyzed oilfields and designed wells. I earned an MBA. I built an apartment building. I managed operations for three factories. I worked on the design and development of some of the most iconic products in the world with an immensely talented team of engineers.

The common thread through these roles is my enduring passion for creating beautiful, high-quality products, and working with a diverse cross-functional team. If my work resonates with you, please reach out and say hi. I’m based in Cupertino, California.
